name: principle-build-the-lever
purpose: Build the smallest rerunnable tool that performs or proves nontrivial work, making its result reviewable.
triggers: Nontrivial edits, migrations, analyses or checks
inputs: A hand-done first unit and its expected result
Available write, execution and worker capabilities
outputs: A safe rerunnable codemod, script, generator or shared delegate skill file
Observed rerun and diff proof, or an explicit reduced proposal and blocked proof
ordinaryExample: Migrate one file by hand, build an idempotent codemod, and rerun it on that file to compare the result before applying it to the remaining files.
capabilityLimits: Writes and commits require authorization; proof requires observed execution and comparisons.
Delegation requires authorization and exposed independent workers; deterministic tools take priority.
No host behavior has been tested.
Preserve disable-model-invocation metadata without assuming host enforcement.
